tools_helpful.evidence: session-log: 'Rewrote Windows.UI.Xaml -> Microsoft.UI.Xaml' handled the bulk of namespace porting before the agent edited files.

tool_limitations.limitation: Mass-rewrite only covers 'Windows.UI.Xaml' -> 'Microsoft.UI.Xaml'. It does not address the WinUI 3 split where the static 'Colors' class moves to Microsoft.UI.Colors while the 'Color' struct stays in Windows.UI, so unqualified 'Colors.Red' usages fail to compile.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Document the Color/Colors namespace split and required 'using Microsoft.UI;' in the build-errors section; have the copy step drop legacy AssemblyInfo.cs.

tool_limitations.limitation: Copies the UWP project's Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs into the migrated tree, which collides with the SDK-style project's auto-generated assembly attributes (CS0579).
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Exclude AssemblyInfo.cs at copy time, mirroring the bin/obj exclusion.

special_apis.special_handling: In WinUI 3 the Colors static palette is Microsoft.UI.Colors but the Color struct it returns is still Windows.UI.Color. Code-behind that sets brush colors needs BOTH 'using Windows.UI;' and 'using Microsoft.UI;'.

errors_encountered.error: CS0103: The name 'Colors' does not exist in the current context (47 occurrences across all 7 scenario code-behind files)
errors_encountered.root_cause: WinUI 3 moved the Colors static class to Microsoft.UI.Colors; the files had 'using Windows.UI;' (for the Color struct) but not 'using Microsoft.UI;', so unqualified 'Colors.Red'/'Colors.Green' did not resolve.
errors_encountered.fix: Added 'using Microsoft.UI;' to every code-behind file that references Colors (session-log line ~5748).

errors_encountered.error: CS1022: Type or namespace definition, or end-of-file expected / WMC9999 Xaml Internal Error (Object reference not set)
errors_encountered.root_cause: Cascading symptoms of the unresolved CS0103 'Colors' errors: the XAML compiler (WMC) and C# end-of-file checks fail while the code-behind does not compile. They cleared once 'using Microsoft.UI;' was added.
errors_encountered.fix: Resolved together with the Colors namespace fix; no separate change required.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The UWP project's Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs was copied into the migrated tree; the SDK-style WinUI csproj auto-generates the same assembly attributes, producing duplicates.
errors_encountered.fix: Added <GenerateAssemblyInfo>false</GenerateAssemblyInfo> to the csproj (session-log line ~6185). Deleting the legacy AssemblyInfo.cs is the cleaner equivalent.

errors_encountered.error: CS0227: Unsafe code may only appear if compiling with /unsafe
errors_encountered.root_cause: Pixel-buffer / AudioFrame code uses unsafe blocks; scaffold csproj had no AllowUnsafeBlocks.
errors_encountered.fix: Added <AllowUnsafeBlocks>true</AllowUnsafeBlocks> — already documented in MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md; agent applied it correctly.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Build flooded with 45+ CS0103 'Colors' errors, plus cascading CS1022 and WMC9999, across two failed build cycles.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Skill's namespace-mapping table lists Windows.UI.Colors -> Microsoft.UI.Colors but does not flag that this requires an explicit 'using Microsoft.UI;' nor that the Color struct stays in Windows.UI; the agent kept 'using Windows.UI;' and assumed Colors was covered.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Agent inferred 'using Microsoft.UI;' is needed and added it to every file.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A build-errors entry for CS0103 'Colors' naming the required 'using Microsoft.UI;' and the Color/Colors split, plus a sharper note on the mapping-table row.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: 12x CS0579 duplicate assembly attribute errors after the C# errors were cleared.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Legacy UWP AssemblyInfo.cs copied into the build tree collides with SDK auto-generated attributes; the skill never mentions AssemblyInfo.cs.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Excluding AssemblyInfo.cs in Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1's copy filter and documenting CS0579 in the build-errors section.

env_issues.issue: No audio output device on the machine ('DeviceNotAvailable'); AudioGraph actions hardware-gated in both apps.
env_issues.workaround: Scoring treated these as inconclusive, not defects; not a migration concern.
